subject: SEND statement
notes: kb/Work PB4743: message-server-name-1 is the name of a message server run unit, a processor-defined name that is no data item; MessagingBinder keeps it a bare word (BoundSendToServer.ServerName) and never resolves it as a data name, so an undefined one is no error. Whether a run unit of that name exists is a run-time fact (EC-MCS-NO-SERVER, slice S4).
